items.q: High haemoglobin with LOW serum erythropoietin and JAK2 mutation establishes which diagnosis?
items.exp: Polycythaemia vera autonomously produces red cells suppressing erythropoietin, with JAK2 in over ninety five percent. Secondary causes raise erythropoietin appropriately from hypoxia or tumours.
r: Incorrect. Hypoxic disease raises EPO, not lowers it.
Correct. Suppressed EPO plus JAK2 means vera.
Incorrect. Dehydration lacks clone and red mass proof.
Incorrect. Tumours secrete excess EPO raising levels.
items.kp: EPO low plus JAK2 equals true vera. EPO high equals secondary.

items.q: Itching after hot showers (aquagenic pruritus) with erythromelalgia and high haematocrit suggests what?
items.exp: Aquagenic pruritus and burning red extremities (erythromelalgia) are classic polycythaemia vera vasomotor symptoms from hyperviscosity and platelet activation, alongside gout and thromboses.
r: Incorrect. Iron deficiency itch lacks this water trigger pattern.
Correct. Shower itch means polycythaemia vera until disproven.
Incorrect. Urticaria wheals with triggers differently.
Incorrect. Thyroid itch lacks erythrocytosis context.
items.kp: Itch after water plus thick blood equals vera.

items.q: Teardrop red cells, nucleated red cells with immature white cells (leukoerythroblastic film) and massive spleen indicate what?
items.exp: Fibrotic marrow squeezes out teardrop cells and early progenitors while spleen resumes blood production enormously. Dry tap aspiration and reticulin biopsy confirm myelofibrosis.
r: Incorrect. Aplasia empties marrow and blood without this film.
Correct. Dacrocytes plus leukoerythroblastosis mean fibrosis.
Incorrect. Iron lack microcytes without leukoerythroblastic change.
Incorrect. Leukaemia blasts dominate differently without dacrocyte spleen pattern.
items.kp: Teardrops plus huge spleen equals marrow fibrosis.

items.q: Hepatic vein thrombosis (Budd Chiari) in a young woman should prompt testing for which occult clone?
o: JAK2 positive myeloproliferative neoplasm (often polycythaemia vera)
items.exp: Unusual site thromboses (hepatic, portal, cerebral veins) frequently reveal occult JAK2 myeloproliferative neoplasms even with near normal counts from portal sequestration and haemodilution.
r: Incorrect. Leiden favours leg and lung veins typically.
Correct. Test JAK2 after Budd Chiari.
Incorrect. Protein C lacks this strong splanchnic link.
Incorrect. Antiphospholipid is a differential, not the clone sought.
items.kp: Odd vein clots mean hunt the JAK2 clone.

items.q: Isolated thrombocytosis over years with CALR mutation and no JAK2 most likely is what?
items.exp: Essential thrombocythaemia is clonal platelet overproduction (JAK2, CALR or MPL driven) with thrombotic and haemorrhagic risk, after excluding reactive causes like infection, inflammation, iron deficiency and splenectomy.
r: Incorrect. Reactive rises resolve with cause and lack mutations.
Correct. CALR clonal platelets mean essential thrombocythaemia.
Incorrect. CML needs BCR ABL1 proof and leukocytosis dominance.
Incorrect. Iron deficiency raises platelets reactively without clone.
items.kp: Clonal platelets with CALR equal essential thrombocythaemia.

items.q: Philadelphia chromosome t(9;22) BCR ABL1 with leukocytosis, basophilia and splenomegaly defines which disease and targeted drug?
o: Chronic myeloid leukaemia treated with imatinib kinase inhibition
CLL treated with BTK inhibitors only
items.exp: BCR ABL1 constitutive kinase drives CML chronic phase, transformed by tyrosine kinase inhibitors (imatinib successors) into near normal lifespan with molecular monitoring. Basophilia and left shift with mature predominance characterise blood.
r: Incorrect. ATRA treats PML RARA promyelocytic disease.
Correct. BCR ABL CML answers to imatinib class drugs.
Incorrect. CLL lacks Philadelphia chromosome definition.
Incorrect. Myeloma is plasma cell marrow disease.
items.kp: Philadelphia plus basophilia equals CML. Block the kinase.

items.q: Older adult cytopenias with cellular dysplastic marrow, ring sideroblasts and low blasts indicate which syndrome group?
items.exp: MDS clones produce dysplastic ineffective haematopoiesis causing cytopenias despite cellular marrows, graded by blasts, cytogenetics and ring sideroblast genetics toward leukaemia risk.
r: Incorrect. Proliferative diseases overproduce mature cells instead.
Correct. Dysplastic ineffective clones mean MDS.
Incorrect. Aplasia is hypocellular without dysplastic clone.
Incorrect. Vitamin deficiency dysplasia reverses without clonal markers.
items.kp: Full marrow, empty blood, dysplastic shapes: MDS.

items.q: MDS with isolated 5q deletion (macrocytic anaemia, normal or high platelets) uniquely responds to which drug?
items.exp: Del(5q) MDS (haploinsufficient RPS14) causes macrocytic anaemia with hypolobated megakaryocytes and striking lenalidomide transfusion independence. Cytogenetic subtype therefore directly selects therapy.
r: Incorrect. Imatinib targets BCR ABL and KIT lesions.
Correct. Lenalidomide transforms del(5q) MDS.
Incorrect. Hydroxyurea cytoreduces proliferative diseases.
Incorrect. EPO helps selected low risk MDS anaemia generally.
items.kp: Delete 5q, give lenalidomide: subtype selects drug.

items.q: Extreme thrombocytosis in essential thrombocythaemia can paradoxically bleed through loss of which factor multimers?
o: Acquired von Willebrand syndrome from adsorption of large multimers onto platelets
items.exp: Counts above roughly 1000 to 1500 strip high molecular weight von Willebrand multimers onto platelet surfaces causing acquired von Willebrand bleeding despite thrombocytosis, guiding cytoreduction and aspirin caution.
r: Incorrect. Factor VIII is carried but multimer loss is the lesion.
Correct. Acquired vWD explains bleeding with huge counts.
Incorrect. Fibrinogen is normal in this paradox.
Incorrect. Congenital receptor defects present lifelong differently.
items.kp: Too many platelets can bleed: they soak up von Willebrand factor.

items.q: Mastocytosis systemic form is driven by which mutation and mediator marker?
o: KIT D816V with raised serum tryptase and flushing, anaphylaxis
items.exp: Systemic mastocytosis clones carry KIT D816V expanding mast cells whose tryptase marks burden, causing flushing, anaphylaxis, osteoporosis and organ infiltration, often with another haematological neoplasm.
r: Incorrect. JAK2 drives classic MPN without mast cell tryptase pattern.
Correct. KIT mutation plus tryptase means mastocytosis.
Incorrect. BCR ABL defines CML without mast cell syndrome.
Incorrect. CALR drives platelet or fibrosis phenotypes.
items.kp: Flush plus tryptase plus KIT equals mast cell clone.
